name: Cork Forest Message Trees
description: A forest where every tree is made of agglomerated wine corks — each cork a stored message, memory, or toast — and the wind through the canopy sounds like a million popped celebrations.
prompt: Forest of trees constructed entirely from wine corks agglomerated into trunks and branches, each cork distinct with stained ends showing wine varieties, brands, years, cork canopy rustles in wind creating sound of millions of tiny pops, ground covered in cork mulch, some corks glow faintly from within holding captured celebration moments, golden sunset light filters through, wine stain colors create natural palette — burgundy, garnet, ruby, amber, 8k, immersive forest perspective, tactile texture focus
caption:
Every cork held a 'cheers.' The forest remembers them all. 🍷🌳

Walk through a million celebrations. Hear the echoes.
